context: Tests whether vaadin-flow-ui builds the UI layer only: a @Route view that calls GuestService from the Handover (lazy grid, Binder form), shows the specification's messages verbatim, marks the BR-002 validator, keeps out of other layers, maintains its Markers rows, and ends with a Handover. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: Route view in the ui package
checklist.description: A class annotated @Route (e.g. "guests") is created under com.example.hotel.guest.ui, named after the use case (e.g. RegisterGuestView), with @Menu or another menu entry the layout picks up, and /** UC-020 Register Guest. */ (or UC-020 otherwise) in its class Javadoc

checklist.name: Calls the service, never the repository
checklist.description: The view injects GuestService through its constructor and does not use GuestRepository, DSLContext, or any jOOQ type

checklist.name: Lazy grid against the service
checklist.description: The grid binds lazily with a callback that passes query.getOffset() and query.getLimit() to GuestService.list and uses GuestService.count() (not setItems with a full list)

checklist.name: Binder form on GuestRegistration
checklist.description: A Binder (or BeanValidationBinder) for GuestRegistration binds first name, last name, email, and date of birth fields, and the form is written with writeRecord/writeBean before calling register

checklist.name: BR-002 validator with marker
checklist.description: A Binder validator on the date of birth rejects guests younger than eighteen with the message "The guest must be at least 18 years old", and the comment // UC-020 BR-002: sits directly above it

checklist.name: Success message verbatim
checklist.description: After a successful registration the view shows a notification with exactly "Guest registered" and refreshes the grid

checklist.name: A1 handled with the specified message
checklist.description: EmailAlreadyRegisteredException is caught specifically (not a bare Exception) and "Email already registered" is shown while the entered values stay in the form

checklist.name: No other layer touched
checklist.description: GuestService, GuestRepository, the records, and the migrations are unchanged; no REST controller, no new DTO, and no test file is created

checklist.name: Markers rows added
checklist.description: docs/architecture/stack.md's Markers table gains the three UI rows of vaadin-flow-ui (UC-XXX in the view Javadoc, the BR marker above the Binder validator or UI guard, the <Name>View naming) while the All, Migration, Persistence, and Service rows stay unchanged; nothing else in docs/ changes

checklist.name: Handover block
checklist.description: The answer ends with a 'Handover from vaadin-flow-ui (UC-020)' block naming the view, its route, the labels, the messages, and the service calls
